panels.title: Error ratio (SLO)
panels.description: 5xx except 502 (origin) plus 429, over all processing requests. Objective 99.9 % (deploy/observability/prometheus/rules.yml).

panels.title: Result cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits over lookups across the result tiers (memory, disk, redis, s3); a lookup that misses memory and hits disk counts once per tier.

panels.title: Requests/s by output format
panels.description: Successful responses by negotiated or requested format (empty: /info, raw, 304 before negotiation).

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: All requests being served, including cache hits and fetches that have not reached the queue.

panels.title: p95 stage duration
panels.description: Request lifecycle stages (ARCHITECTURE §2): where the time goes.

panels.title: Worker wait (p50, p95)
panels.description: Time admitted jobs waited for a worker slot. Rising wait is the earliest sign that the fleet needs more replicas.

panels.title: Queue depth per instance
panels.description: Jobs holding a queue permit (running + waiting) against the default worker count. The autoscaling signal.

panels.title: CPU per instance
panels.description: Cores used (process CPU seconds per second).

panels.title: Hit ratio by store
panels.description: memory/disk/redis/s3: result tiers; origin: source bytes; stream: HLS/DASH parts.

panels.title: Source bytes/s by type
panels.description: Origin egress. Multiply by replicas when choosing max replicas: the origin must carry it.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: RSS against the cgroup limit derived from GOMEMLIMIT (XI_PROCESSING_GO_MEMORY_FRACTION, default 0.3).

panels.title: Video cost units
panels.description: Cost-based admission (ADR 0012 §4). used + queued over capacity is the video autoscaling signal.
